name: pstack
description: Portable atomic playbooks and principles across agent harnesses.

roles.description: Parallel candidate generation and cross-judge synthesis

commands.name: poteto-mode
commands.description: Enter poteto-mode: disciplined agent workflow and principles
commands.prompt: Enter /poteto-mode {{args}}. Read the poteto-mode skill in full and follow its discipline: if you want to go fast, go deep first; write less, but higher quality code; rigorous agent workflows parallelized with confidence.

commands.name: architect
commands.prompt: Run /architect {{args}}. Design system boundaries, contracts, and deep modules.

commands.name: arena
commands.description: Run multi-model arena competitive design comparison
commands.prompt: Run /arena {{args}}. Compare candidate approaches across diverse models and synthesize a winning approach.

commands.name: swarm
commands.description: Execute multi-agent swarm partition and synthesis
commands.prompt: Run /swarm {{args}}. Follow the swarm skill to partition work across subagents and synthesize results with PASS/ISSUES/BLOCKED reports.

commands.name: interrogate
commands.description: Run adversarial interrogation and review on changes or plans
commands.prompt: Run /interrogate {{args}}. Audit against failure modes, edge cases, missing evidence, and unverified assumptions.

commands.name: tdd
commands.prompt: Execute /tdd {{args}}. Write red tests first, verify failure, implement minimal code, make tests green, and refactor.

commands.name: why
commands.description: Investigate why a decision, bug, or design pattern exists
commands.prompt: Run /why {{args}}. Uncover root causes, historical context, and architectural rationale.

commands.name: how
commands.description: Investigate how a subsystem or flow works
commands.prompt: Run /how {{args}}. Trace data paths, call graphs, and lifecycle state transitions.

commands.name: reflect
commands.description: Reflect on session progress, learnings, and next steps
commands.prompt: Run /reflect {{args}}. Review what was accomplished, what was deferred, and capture durable lessons.

commands.name: create-verification-skill
commands.description: Create a new verification skill with offline levers
commands.prompt: Run /create-verification-skill {{args}}. Scaffold an offline verification skill following the verification skill lifecycle.

commands.name: maintain-verification-skill
commands.description: Update and maintain an existing verification skill
commands.prompt: Run /maintain-verification-skill {{args}}. Update verification levers, predicates, and evidence matrices.

commands.name: deslop
commands.description: Remove AI code slop, redundant abstractions, and comments
commands.prompt: Remove AI code slop {{args}}. Strip unnecessary boilerplate, speculative abstractions, defensive checks, and commentary.

commands.name: thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review
commands.prompt: Run /thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review {{args}}. Perform an unusually strict review focused on abstraction quality, maintainability, and architectural health.

commands.name: babysit
commands.description: Watch an open PR — fix failing CI, address feedback, and drive to mergeable
commands.prompt: Run /babysit {{args}}. Shepherd open pull requests to green, resolve CI checks, triage review comments, and ensure clean mergeability.

commands.name: fix-ci
commands.description: Find failing PR checks and apply focused fixes
commands.prompt: Run /fix-ci {{args}}. Inspect failing checks and apply focused fixes to achieve green CI.

commands.name: fix-merge-conflicts
commands.prompt: Run /fix-merge-conflicts {{args}}. Resolve merge conflicts non-interactively with minimal, correctness-first edits.

commands.name: get-pr-comments
commands.description: Fetch and summarize review comments from active PR
commands.prompt: Run /get-pr-comments {{args}}. Fetch and summarize review comments from the active pull request.

commands.name: make-pr-easy-to-review
commands.description: Prepare PRs for review by cleaning history and descriptions
commands.prompt: Run /make-pr-easy-to-review {{args}}. Prepare pull requests for review by cleaning noisy history and improving PR descriptions.

commands.name: what-did-i-get-done
commands.description: Summarize authored commits over a specified time period
commands.prompt: Run /what-did-i-get-done {{args}}. Summarize authored commits over a specified time period into a concise update.
